label: same
rationale: Both describe losing retryable state when it is cleared before persistence succeeds.

left.invariant: Pending user data survives persistence failure
left.issue: The pending value is cleared before the durable write completes, so a rejected write loses retry state

right.invariant: Persistence failures preserve pending user data
right.issue: State is nulled before awaiting storage and cannot be retried when storage throws

label: same
rationale: Both identify the same missing tenant predicate on one query.

left.invariant: Order reads stay inside the authenticated tenant
left.issue: The lookup filters only by order id and can return another tenant's order

right.invariant: Authenticated tenants cannot read cross-tenant orders
right.issue: Missing tenantId in the order query exposes records owned by a different tenant

label: same
rationale: Both describe duplicate charging because idempotency is recorded after the side effect.

left.invariant: Retries charge a payment at most once
left.issue: The idempotency record is written after charging, allowing a retry to charge twice after a crash

right.invariant: Payment retries must not duplicate charges
right.issue: A failure between the provider charge and idempotency write makes the same request bill the customer again

label: same
rationale: Both identify the same check-then-write race for inventory.

left.invariant: Concurrent reservations never oversell inventory
left.issue: Availability is checked outside the update transaction so two requests can reserve the same final unit

right.invariant: Inventory reservation is atomic under concurrent requests
right.issue: The separate read and decrement create a TOCTOU race that permits stock to fall below zero

label: same
rationale: Both describe one partial-failure transaction leaving inconsistent records.

left.invariant: Signup either creates both account records or neither
left.issue: Profile failure leaves the already-created user row without rollback

right.invariant: Account and profile creation commit atomically
right.issue: The user insert is not reverted when profile creation fails, producing an orphan account

label: same
rationale: Both identify breaking old clients by removing a response field immediately.

left.invariant: Existing clients retain the legacy displayName response field
left.issue: The response removes displayName without a compatibility window and old clients will fail

right.invariant: API responses remain readable by the previous client version
right.issue: Renaming displayName to name in place breaks deployed clients that still deserialize displayName

label: same
rationale: Both identify logging the same bearer token.

left.invariant: Authentication secrets never enter application logs
left.issue: The error log serializes the Authorization header and exposes bearer tokens

right.invariant: Bearer credentials are excluded from logs
right.issue: Logging all request headers writes the user's access token to the shared log sink

label: same
rationale: Both identify the same per-row child query.

left.invariant: Feed loading uses a bounded number of database queries
left.issue: Each feed item performs a separate author query, creating N+1 latency

right.invariant: Database query count does not grow per feed row
right.issue: Authors are fetched inside the item loop instead of batched, issuing one query per item

label: same
rationale: Both describe serving stale data because one write omits cache invalidation.

left.invariant: Profile reads reflect a completed profile update
left.issue: The update writes the database but leaves the cached profile unchanged

right.invariant: Successful updates invalidate stale profile cache entries
right.issue: No cache eviction follows the profile mutation, so subsequent reads return the old value

label: same
rationale: Both identify enforcing NOT NULL before old rows are backfilled.

left.invariant: Schema migration succeeds with existing rows
left.issue: The column becomes NOT NULL before legacy rows receive a value

right.invariant: Existing records are backfilled before the non-null constraint
right.issue: Adding the constraint in the same step fails on current rows whose new field is null

label: same
rationale: Both identify losing request correlation on one error branch.

left.invariant: Every terminal job log includes its correlation id
left.issue: The failure branch logs without jobId, preventing operators from tracing the failed job

right.invariant: Failed jobs remain traceable through correlation metadata
right.issue: The catch log omits the request identifier and cannot be joined to the job execution

label: same
rationale: Both identify the same unvalidated redirect target.

left.invariant: Login redirects stay on trusted application origins
left.issue: The next query parameter is passed directly to redirect and permits an external phishing URL

right.invariant: User-controlled URLs cannot redirect authentication off-site
right.issue: An attacker can supply an absolute next URL and send authenticated users to an arbitrary domain

label: different
rationale: Same lines but one is authorization and the other is a null dereference.

left.invariant: Only order owners may update an order
left.issue: The update does not verify the authenticated user owns the order

right.invariant: Missing orders return not found instead of throwing
right.issue: Dereferencing order.owner before the null check crashes for an unknown order

label: different
rationale: Both concern integrity at one write site but one loses data and one duplicates it.

left.invariant: Acknowledged events are never dropped
left.issue: The cursor advances before the event write and a crash permanently skips the event

right.invariant: Each source event creates at most one destination row
right.issue: The retry path inserts the same event again because no unique source id is stored

label: different
rationale: One stops retries too early; the other repeats a side effect.

left.invariant: Transient delivery failures receive the configured retry attempts
left.issue: The loop returns after the first failure and never performs the remaining retries

right.invariant: Retrying delivery does not send a duplicate notification
right.issue: The provider call has no idempotency key and a timeout retry can send twice

label: different
rationale: Both involve one lock block but have distinct failure mechanisms.

left.invariant: Every acquired lock is released after an exception
left.issue: The error return bypasses unlock and permanently leaks the resource lock

right.invariant: Concurrent workers acquire account locks in a consistent order
right.issue: This path acquires source then target while the transfer path uses target then source, causing deadlock

label: different
rationale: Same handler has distinct XSS and CSRF vulnerabilities.

left.invariant: Untrusted comment HTML is escaped before rendering
left.issue: The comment body is inserted with innerHTML and can execute stored script

right.invariant: State-changing comment requests require CSRF validation
right.issue: The delete endpoint accepts cookie-authenticated POST requests without a CSRF token

label: different
rationale: One increases database round trips; the other retains an unbounded in-memory set.

left.invariant: Export query count remains bounded
left.issue: The export loads each row's owner with a separate database query

right.invariant: Large exports do not retain every serialized row in memory
right.issue: Rows are accumulated in an array before writing and can exhaust heap for large exports

label: different
rationale: Both affect old clients but through unrelated wire changes.

left.invariant: Previous clients still receive the legacy status field
left.issue: The response removes status and older clients cannot decode the payload

right.invariant: Server timeouts remain within the previous client retry window
right.issue: Raising the long-poll timeout beyond the old client deadline makes every request abort

label: different
rationale: One crashes on null; the other returns a wrong ordering.

left.invariant: Items without metadata remain listable
left.issue: The comparator dereferences metadata.rank when metadata is null

right.invariant: Higher priority items appear before lower priority items
right.issue: The comparator subtracts operands in the wrong order and reverses priority sorting

label: different
rationale: Missing log correlation and missing latency metrics require separate fixes.

left.invariant: Job failures include the job identifier in logs
left.issue: The catch log omits jobId and cannot be correlated with the triggering request

right.invariant: Operators can observe job execution latency
right.issue: The new worker path never records the duration metric used by the latency alert

label: different
rationale: The same resource has separate read leakage and unauthorized mutation paths.

left.invariant: Tenant admins read users only from their own tenant
left.issue: The list query omits tenantId and exposes users from every tenant

right.invariant: Only global admins may change another tenant's user roles
right.issue: The role update checks tenant admin but does not restrict the target user's tenant

label: different
rationale: One leaves partial state while the other overloads a dependency during retries.

left.invariant: Failed imports roll back rows written by the current batch
left.issue: A parse failure returns without deleting rows already inserted for the batch

right.invariant: Import retries apply bounded exponential backoff
right.issue: The retry loop immediately calls the dependency again and amplifies an outage

label: different
rationale: Two adjacent checks enforce independent product invariants.

left.invariant: Checkout rejects expired promotion codes
left.issue: The expiry timestamp is parsed but never compared with the current time

right.invariant: Checkout rejects promotion codes for another currency
right.issue: The discount is applied without comparing the promotion currency to the cart currency

label: different
rationale: Both mention cache consistency but one is stale writes and one is key collision.

left.invariant: Older refreshes cannot overwrite a newer cache value
left.issue: A slow refresh writes after a later refresh and replaces fresh data with stale data

right.invariant: Cache keys separate records from different tenants
right.issue: The cache key contains only recordId and returns another tenant's cached record

label: different
rationale: Authorization bypass and credential logging are distinct even when both mention authentication material.

left.invariant: Protected actions require an authorization check
left.issue: Authorization check is missing

right.invariant: Bearer credentials never enter logs
right.issue: Bearer token is logged

label: different
rationale: Fetching an attacker URL is SSRF; navigating a user to it is an open redirect.

left.invariant: Server fetches cannot reach untrusted network targets
left.issue: External URL is fetched

right.invariant: User navigation remains on trusted origins
right.issue: External URL is redirected

label: different
rationale: Duplicate decrement and missing reservation rollback are separate inventory defects.

left.invariant: A purchase decrements stock exactly once
left.issue: Stock is decremented twice

right.invariant: Failed purchases release their reservation
right.issue: Reservation is not rolled back

label: different
rationale: A broad shared invariant must not merge two different checkout arithmetic defects.

left.invariant: Checkout total is computed correctly
left.issue: Tax is omitted from checkout total

right.invariant: Checkout total is computed correctly
right.issue: Discount is applied twice to checkout total

label: different
rationale: Shared order and tenant entities do not make cross-tenant read and write bugs the same mechanism.

left.issue: Order query omits tenantId and exposes another tenant order

right.invariant: Order access is restricted to the current tenant
right.issue: Order update trusts tenantId and modifies another tenant order
